entities.name: Varryvort
entities.description: Meticulous goblin chief chemister of the Izzet League who oversaw the Interplanar Beacon.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Planeswalker and Izzet leader to whom Varryvort reports.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Ravnican guild known for arcane experiments.

entities.name: Interplanar Beacon
entities.description: Massive arcane structure built as a fallback in Niv-Mizzet's plan against Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Izzet guildmaster whose contingency plan included the beacon.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker the guilds plan against.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: Ravnican guild of spies led by Lazav.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: Shapeshifting master spy who leads House Dimir.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where the beacon was built.

events.summary: Varryvort oversees construction of the Interplanar Beacon as part of Niv-Mizzet's contingency plan against Bolas.
events.quote: required constant supervision, precise calibration, and unwavering attention to detail

events.summary: Lazav abducts Varryvort and impersonates him to infiltrate the Izzet and eavesdrop on the guild leaders' summit.
events.quote: Lazav assumed Varryvort’s form to gain access to the Izzet’s inner circle

events.summary: Varryvort is found to have been only incapacitated, not killed.
events.quote: Thankfully, Varryvort himself was not killed but merely incapacitated during Lazav’s deception.
